summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing preliminary unaudited Q1 2026 financial results and updated fiscal year 2026 guidance. The filing includes expected total revenue of $65.4-$65.6 million (up 14.3% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $10.8-$11.0 million, and ARR of $248.9 million. Revised FY2026 guidance: revenue $271-$273 million. No special situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, activist, etc.) is announced. The filing is a routine earnings pre-announcement, not a corporate event triggering a special-situations classification.
